author: Bobby Grayson
description:
Performance became urgent issue when ripgrep used with tools that pass many arguments. Also poor error messages compared to alternatives.

Sources:
- 92dc402: 'Performance. Docopt does poorly when the argv becomes large, which is a reasonable common use case for search tools. (e.g., use with xargs)... Better failure modes. Clap knows a lot more about how a particular argv might be invalid, and can therefore provide much clearer error messages.'
title: Docopt performs poorly with large argv (common with xargs)
